plan: For capital preservation, sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and align with the conservative mandate.
This plan prioritizes reducing risk and protecting capital by exiting all high-beta and leveraged positions.
Maintain a significant cash buffer for stability and future opportunities.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: For balanced growth, trim all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero to reduce overall leverage.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and align with the balanced mandate.
Buy TECS at 4% as a strong scanner long setup to add quality exposure.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth potential, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner long setup. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced risk-reward profile.

plan: For aggressive growth, trim SPY to 25% to cure the concentration breach.
Buy TECS at 6%, SQQQ at 6%, and SOXS at 6% as strong scanner long setups.
This plan leans into high-scoring setups and uses leverage to amplify potential returns.
Maintain strict stop discipline to manage the increased risk and potential for rapid drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It leverages high-scoring scanner setups, which significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for substantial losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: For income, sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and free up capital.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 30% of the book, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on generating reliable income with lower drawdown potential, maintaining a cash buffer.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes steady monthly distributions from income ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting high-beta and leveraged names. While aiming for low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
